name: Needle
subtitle: Your music, on your iPhone.
description: Needle for iPhone, for SideStore and AltStore. Each phone signs it with its own Apple ID.

apps.name: Needle
apps.subtitle: Your music, on your iPhone.
apps.localizedDescription:
Needle is a music player for the songs you own.

- Your library on your iPhone, made for Liquid Glass.
- A full player in the cover's colours, with lyrics that follow the song word by word.
- Lock Screen, Control Center, AirPlay, Bluetooth, Chromecast and DLNA speakers.
- Widgets for the song playing, recent albums, playlists and your week of listening.
- Play from Navidrome and other music servers.
- Control Needle on your computer, and move what plays between the computer and the phone.
- A 10-band and parametric equalizer, headphone corrections, crossfeed and crossfade.
- Playlists, smart playlists, tag editing, and tools to find duplicates and covers.
- Discord status: show what you play on your profile.

No account and no tracking. Needle goes online only for things that you turn on.

versions.localizedDescription:
Needle for iPhone, now on SideStore.

- Discord status: link your Discord account in Settings › Discord, and your profile shows what you play.
- Lyrics from your music server: songs from Navidrome get the lyrics your server has, even with online lookups off.
- When a song has no lyrics, a button turns on online lookups.
- Long lyric lines no longer run past the edge of the screen.

privacy.NSCameraUsageDescription: Needle reads the QR code of the phone remote on your computer.
privacy.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: Needle connects to Needle on your computer and to music servers on your home network.
